cultural.vision_reason: Studio carte-de-visite portrait of two Paiute men in traditional dress — ear ornaments, cloth/fur blankets, moccasins, leggings, and a fur/bear-claw item — a documentary photo of the people's clothing and material culture, consistent with the claimed ethnicity.

physical.title: photographic print (black and white); album
physical.summary:
Photograph (black and white) from an album, of a carte de visite; studio portrait of two Paiute Native North Americans; the Paiute man standing on the left is wearing ear ornaments, a cloth shirt, a banket wrapped around themselves, a pair of leggings with flaps (partially visible), and a pair of moccasins; the Paiute man standing on the right has a section of his hair in a plait wrapped in cloth(?), he is wearing ear ornaments, a fur and hide blanket wrapped around himself, and holding a fur item with bear claws running along both sides; Salt Lake City, United States of America 
Albumen print
